description: This file defines a Roslyn Diagnostic Analyzer for C# that inspects class, struct, record, and record struct declarations to suggest adding serialization attributes and checks for proper attribute usage within the Orleans project.

classes.name: GenerateSerializationAttributesAnalyzer
classes.description: A Roslyn diagnostic analyzer that enforces serialization attribute correctness in Orleans source code.

methods.name: Initialize
methods.description: Initializes the analyzer, setting up the syntax node actions for class, struct, record, and record struct declarations.

methods.name: CheckSyntaxNode
methods.description: Analyzes syntax nodes to determine if they should trigger a diagnostic based on their attributes and members.

methods.name: GetGenerateFieldIdsValue
methods.description: Extracts the value of the GenerateFieldIds parameter from a given attribute syntax.
